limitations: Guest/unconfigured checks use the production bridge and browser memory storage with an explicitly empty test-response configuration, independent of deployed public settings.

Configured account, admin, Public email signup, confirmation-required and admin student-detail and cloud checks replace SDK transport in a routed HTML response with a deterministic test double. Every fixture replaces the configuration generically and blocks external network requests. No production test switch exists.
These checks do not prove live email delivery, Supabase availability, hosted RLS or a deployed account service.
